metadata.name: stage4-netboot-path-b
metadata.description: Publish and operate the Path B iPXE asset tree for Gentoo provisioning on bare-metal and VM fleets.

variables.name: ansible_root
variables.description: Ansible subtree used for netboot asset publishing.

variables.name: inventory
variables.description: Inventory containing the netboot_publishers host group.

variables.name: publish_root
variables.description: Filesystem path where iPXE assets are rendered.

variables.name: public_base_url
variables.description: Base URL from which iPXE clients fetch rendered assets.

stages.summary: Build the Gentoo provisioning kernel, initramfs, and SquashFS roots for the Path B installer and rescue roles.
Render the iPXE bootstrap, menu, role, host, and manifest files for Path B.
Inspect rendered per-host iPXE entry points before handing the asset tree to DHCP or HTTP boot infrastructure.
Expose the published Path B tree through DHCP/TFTP plus iPXE HTTP, or UEFI HTTP boot plus iPXE chainload.
command: printf 'Publish %s to your DHCP/iPXE/HTTP boot infrastructure.\n' "${publish_root}"
notes: Path B is intended to boot a provisioning environment that then runs the same Stage4 Ansible workflow used by Path A.
Keep Path A available for hosts that cannot join the iPXE network.
